# Explicit file argument works.
sngl check single/app.sngl
stdout 'single/app.sngl: ok'

# Current directory discovery.
sngl check
stdout 'app.sngl: ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component main node {
}

app.window {
    main
}
